events.clean_summary: Microsoft's Satya Nadella says AI models need an 'emergency brake'
events.why_it_matters: Nadella的'紧急刹车'言论为开源Agent项目提供了重要的安全叙事切入点。创作者可将此转化为'如何在OpenClaw/CrewAI中实现可控停机'的实战指南，填补主流内容中对开源工具安全机制讨论的空白。这直接影响Agent工具链的信任度构建，适合制作深度解析类内容。

suggested_action.text: 在OpenClaw或CrewAI中编写一个模拟'紧急停止'按钮的测试脚本，录制5分钟演示视频，展示如何防止Agent无限循环调用API。

events.headline: 3 days to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Meet the startups before they hit mainstream
events.clean_summary: 3 days to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Meet the startups before they hit mainstream
events.why_it_matters: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026即将开幕，为开源创作者提供了挖掘早期Agent工具的黄金窗口。抢先接触未量产项目，可制作'Disrupt前沿Agent预览'系列内容，建立行业嗅觉敏锐的人设。这与常规新闻点评不同，侧重情报收集和趋势预判，具有独特时效价值。

suggested_action.text: 访问TechCrunch Disrupt 2026官网，筛选所有标注'AI Agent'或'Autonomous'的初创公司名单，整理成一份包含GitHub链接的'待体验Agent清单'。

events.headline: Here are the top AI agents that can live in your text messages
events.clean_summary: Here are the top AI agents that can live in your text messages

suggested_action.text: 选择一款开源消息Agent框架，编写代码接入一个常见短信API（如Twilio Sandbox），搭建一个能回复预设关键词的简易短信Bot。

events.headline: Anthropic can't reliably control its AI agents. It's cutting off its internal evals from the live internet instead
events.clean_summary: Anthropic can't reliably control its AI agents. It's cutting off its internal evals from the live internet instead

suggested_action.text: 克隆AutoGen仓库，配置一个完全离线的Agent环境，测试其能否在断网情况下安全完成预设任务，并记录失败率作为评测内容素材。
